question: In which state is the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• It is recognized for its diverse flora and fauna, including several endangered species.
 
• The reserve is part of the **UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves since 2004**.
